# pdf.js (vendored)

Mozilla's PDF reader, from the npm package [`pdfjs-dist`](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js)
version 6.4.299, legacy build (`legacy/build/`, works on older iPhones too), unchanged.
The package checksum was verified against the npm registry.

PitSide uses it only in the notebook template editor, to show the pages of an uploaded
notebook PDF so you can pick sample pages. See `js/pdfpages.js`.
